name: Pixel Pythons
made_by: Scout's tools, researched in Juan's laptop session
note: A fantasy roster: the seven players play for different NFL teams, so this describes how these players are used, not one real offense.
source: Scout's research tools (agents/scout/research.py) over data/rosters/plays-2026.json: https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/summary?event={event}. Season weeks 1 to 10, read on 2026-11-14. Trend labels and the summary are judgment, written by hand from the per-player reports in data/profiles/notes/.
summary: Run first through Robinson, who carries 18.8 times a game, owns the goal line and catches passes. Jackson is efficient when he plays but has barely played since week 4, so the passing numbers are a small sample. Nabers is the deep threat, Kittle and Collins score in the red zone, and Jefferson and Nabers get the third down targets. Third down is the weak spot of this roster.
